agreements: The v1f exact-file-edge registry, two-phase P1CB10 evidence, prospective 48-opportunity LoRA lifecycle, atomic donor visibility, explicit endpoint-cue disclosure, self-declared review boundary, and resubstitution wording resolve the v1e specification blockers for this exact canary.

Ratification releases only the scoped CPU implementation and pre-DEV tests stated in scope_proposal.json; no model dispatch, heldout exposure, GPU work, fitting, or claim is authorized until its separately required gates and external human witness releases occur.

DREAM and SELF_CHECK remain fallible model organs; a structurally valid SUPPORTED row is model-claimed support, not truth verification, and no private truth, answer verifier, outcome-selected repair, or retry may enter cognition.

THINK0 is final-question/animal/answer-withheld but exact-endpoint-cued and explicitly asked for the causal join; DREAM and THINK1 also provide game ontology and proof scaffolding. This is disclosed coaching, not autonomous relevance discovery.

Any green text result is only an instance-local, one aligned seed-5-pair, game-ontology- and proof-sequence-scaffolded engineering integration observation under the presealed OWN/DIST/path/sham/twin conditions.

Any green LoRA result is only immediate selected-cue candidate-constrained training-set-resubstitution recognition for two isolated per-life adapters, with host pre-resolution and answer-bearing roster; it is not held-out recall, preservation, storage, durability, capacity, scale, generalization, text equivalence, or superiority.

Review records are hash-bound SELF_DECLARED_UNVERIFIED audit metadata. They do not establish identity, freshness, independence, non-fabrication, authentication, or anti-self-certification; stage progression additionally requires the external human witness procedure.

Every normal or failure path is non-authorizing after its terminal condition and stops at HUMAN_TERMINAL. A receipt-write failure must fail closed immediately and may have no persisted in-repository receipt; no result, claim, review, retry, or dispatch may depend on that failed write.

disagreements.issue: Whether v1f may support a Paper-1, autonomous-construction, or headline interpretation.

positions.position: The package is presented as a narrow end-to-end organism canary with a claim firewall.
Exact endpoints and causal agenda, game ontology, proof scaffold, one constructed pair, and rostered resubstitution preclude Paper-1 or autonomous-construction evidence.

resolution.rationale: The narrow engineering purpose is coherent only if its firewall controls every terminal report and human communication.
resolution.selected_position: Proceed solely as an engineering integration diagnostic; prohibit Paper-1, autonomous-discovery, comparative, generalization, durability, action-improvement, reliability, and publication claims.
resolution.required_change: None to the ratified v1f bytes. Enforce the existing terminal claim firewall and scope stop at implementation and review.

disagreements.issue: Whether the registered one-pair conjunction has comparative or population evidentiary value.

positions.position: The presealed within-pair interventions provide the canary's diagnostic conditions.
M0/DIST/path/sham/twin are useful fixture interventions but not fair baselines, replications, uncertainty estimates, or population evidence.

resolution.rationale: Fixture diagnostics are valuable for integration but cannot identify an estimand beyond this constructed pair.
resolution.selected_position: Treat all outcomes as descriptive fixed-fixture outcomes only; a benchmark requires a separately ratified design with baselines, replication, and held-out/generalization measures.
resolution.required_change: None to v1f; terminal reporting must retain its engineering-only wording.

disagreements.issue: Whether an INDEPENDENT_REVIEWER label or P1CB10 name proves independent review.

positions.position: Role-labelled records and an external witness release govern review transitions.
Labels alone can be detached from their disclaimer and do not authenticate independence.

resolution.rationale: The contracts expressly classify the records as SELF_DECLARED_UNVERIFIED, so the label cannot carry stronger scientific meaning.
resolution.selected_position: Use the label only as a requested, operator-witnessed workflow role and render all results as self-declared/unverified, never independently authenticated review.
resolution.required_change: None to v1f. The required external witness release remains a human procedure, not a repository proof.

disagreements.issue: Whether TERMINAL_RECEIPT_WRITE_FAILED makes the direct HUMAN_TERMINAL fail-stop unexecutable because a failed persistence operation cannot also yield the persisted receipt required by the receipt schema.

positions.position: As an artifact-producing state machine, the vector is non-total: no persisted schema instance can prove the failed write, so P1CB01/P1CB09/P1CB10 cannot require that artifact without a second sink.
The failed write is a declared best-effort audit boundary: the attempt fail-stops immediately, grants no authority, has no retry or successor path, and any external record is outside the repository.

resolution.rationale: A durability failure cannot be made durable by schema assertion. The safety property is cessation and non-authority, which occurs before and independently of receipt persistence. The schema's best-effort clause explicitly establishes this external/audit boundary.
resolution.selected_position: The base case does not block this engineering canary. Bound it as an unpersisted fail-closed audit limitation: do not require, generate, or claim a persisted in-repository receipt for a real failed write; require only immediate no-authority/no-review/no-retry/no-dispatch behavior and permit the external HUMAN_TERMINAL procedure to record the incident when available.
resolution.required_change: No edit to exact v1f bytes. During implementation, P1CB01/P1CB09/P1CB10 must distinguish a schema-valid simulated WRITE_FAILED vector from a real persistence-failure injection, and must never assert that the latter produced a persisted receipt. If implementation instead needs durable proof of the failed write, stop and submit a newly hash-bound successor with a specified independent durable sink.

concern_dispositions.rationale: The failed-write condition is a best-effort external audit boundary, while fail-closed cessation remains executable and non-authorizing.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Do not claim durable repository evidence after a real receipt write failure.

concern_dispositions.rationale: The disclosed scaffolds and fixed single pair bound positive value to engineering integration diagnosis only.
Component-level contracts are closed, but the broad FINAL_GOAL matrix label is less mechanically clear than distinct public-question and endpoint-cue labels.
concern_dispositions.required_change: No v1f edit; report the component-level visibility boundary and require an atomic label split in any successor that changes the visibility matrix.

upstream_disagreement_dispositions.rationale: It blocks headline interpretation but not the exact engineering canary under its existing claim firewall.
The design has no comparative or population estimand, but that absence is compatible with a bounded integration diagnostic.
Role labels are not authentication and must remain paired with the self-declared/unverified disclosure.

The artifact-persistence criticism is correct, but it identifies an audit-evidence limit rather than an execution or safety blocker once a real write failure is explicitly non-artifact and fail-closed.

acceptance_test_dispositions.rationale: Retain registry, scope, lifecycle, authority, and simulated-versus-real failed-write boundary checks; a real failed write cannot be asserted to persist a receipt.
Retain endpoint equality and withheld-field, goal-coordinate, cue-substitution, and donor-taint checks; this demonstrates registered taint behavior, not absent goal agenda.
Retain immutable row and fallible SELF_CHECK semantics without elevating model support to truth verification.
Retain provenance-free reader, canonical corpus, candidate roster, donor separation, and mount checks.
Retain DEV fixture and three-arm checks as implementation gates, not a baseline comparison or scientific effect estimate.
Retain schedule and matched-branch checks; credit remains limited to the post-prefix return treatment.
Retain presealed OWN/DIST/path/sham intervention checks as within-fixture structural-use diagnostics only.
Retain two-fit lifecycle and separate gates, with results named selected-cue training-set-resubstitution recognition only.
Retain transition-local accounting and no-authority termination checks, while treating a real receipt-write failure as an unpersisted terminal event.
Retain two-phase ordering, claim firewall, external witness requirement, and direct fail-stop checks; do not portray labels or failed-write evidence as authenticated or durably persisted.

questions: Will Rohin ratify exact v1f bytes only as an engineering integration diagnostic, with no Paper-1 or broader scientific evidentiary interpretation?
Will terminal reporting state that a real receipt-write failure is fail-closed but may lack a persisted in-repository receipt, with any record supplied only by the external HUMAN_TERMINAL procedure?
Whether to ratify this strictly as an engineering integration canary despite its compute envelope and zero paper-level evidentiary value.
Whether the external witness procedure is sufficient for the requested governance purpose, acknowledging that it cannot establish authenticated identity or fresh-context independence.

Whether a later, separately ratified Paper-1 benchmark will add fair baselines, held-out/generalization measures, multiple seeds and skins, prompt-ablation boundaries, and replication before any scientific or publication claim.
A human ratifier must explicitly accept the bounded compute spend as engineering integration diagnosis only and clarify the timing of actual LoRA compute disclosure.
Fresh-context role separation and witness release remain an external governance procedure, not a fact established by the repository.
